children: Stewards entered into a junior secured bridge financing with Accretiv Investment Holdings for $1.5 million via a Promissory Note and Security Agreement. Principal is due on September 21, 2026, and a fixed return of $75,000 (5%) is payable by November 30, 2026, subject to usury savings. The loan is secured by a junior lien on substantially all personal property and is subordinate to existing senior liens. Funding had not occurred as of the filing, and obligations arise upon actual receipt of funds.
: Junior secured short-term bridge promissory note and security agreement
: Principal due Sep 21 2026; fixed return due Nov 30 2026
: Short-term bridge financing to support liquidity pending fund receipts
